headline: Scotland Outclass Haiti in 0-1 Triumph
whyCareReason: A crucial group stage result in Group C that leaves standing tables dramatically altered.
teaser: Tactical discipline and clinical finishes defined this Matchday 1 encounter. Here is how Haiti and Scotland fought out their group stage clash.
story:
Under the bright lights in Seattle, Haiti and Scotland took to the pitch on 2026-06-13 for a highly anticipated Matchday 1 fixture. The tension in the stadium was palpable, reflecting the immense stakes of the tournament.

With both managers deploying disciplined defensive setups, space was at a premium. Frantzdy Pierrot showed moments of brilliance for Haiti, while Andrew Robertson was the creative heartbeat for Scotland. In the end, a few decisive moments settled the score at 0-1, giving fans plenty to talk about.

For the victors, this result represents a massive step toward the knockout rounds. For the defeated, it is back to the drawing board to save their World Cup campaign before the group stage concludes.
stakes: With Group C wide open, this matchday 1 encounter holds massive implications for both Haiti and Scotland as they look to secure a place in the knockout rounds.
rivalryAngle: The footballing connection between Haiti and Scotland adds an extra layer of emotion to this fixture, making it a must-watch for fans.
